title: The Doorbell Button
question: 把今天“聪明办法解决了一个问题，却制造了新习惯”的喜剧线放进门铃按钮场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: My little brother used to shout outside my room. Every time he wanted to come in, he would shout until someone opened the door. My father spent days training him to press a small button. He soon became an expert at pressing it. This time he pressed the button so that someone would bring him snacks. Since then, he has developed another bad habit. As soon as he presses the button, he waits until someone answers. Then he immediately presses it again.
